content_sections.heading: THSTI Data Manager and Project Research Scientist-I Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.information: THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001

content_sections.heading: About THSTI
content_sections.text: BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. It is part of the NCR Biotech Science Cluster in Faridabad, and its mission is to conduct translational research that turns concepts into products to improve human health. These posts are at THSTI's Clinical Development Services Agency (CDSA). CDSA supports not-for-profit preclinical and clinical product development and clinical research carried out by public agencies.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Data Manager and Project Research Scientist-I Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Both posts are under the project "Sepsis related mortality in neonates in India: A multi-disciplinary, multi-institutional research program for context specific solutions". The notice says the number of vacancies may change, depending on actual requirements at the time of the written test, skill test or interview. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: THSTI Data Manager and Project Research Scientist-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for both posts is up to 35 years. The notice states that age, essential qualification and experience are judged as on the closing date of application, which it calls the crucial date. Essential qualification and experience (either one): Master's degree in any field, preferably in science, with 6 years of experience in clinical data management/clinical research/operations/MIS/data analysis/IT/computer science/healthcare field Graduation degree in any field, preferably in science, with 8 years of experience in clinical data management/clinical research/operations/MIS/data analysis/IT/computer science/healthcare field Desirable: Diploma in Clinical research and clinical data management; familiarity with industry-standard CDMS and some programming skills; preparation of Clinical Study Data Management documents. Skills listed: management and leadership skills; IT literacy (Microsoft applications, data visualization and other CDMS applications); experience in handling databases and query management, which the notice lists as a must; an understanding of clinical trials and clinical data management functions, also listed as a must; good communication, negotiation and organisational skills; time management; and the ability to work independently. Essential qualification: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. Desirable: Postgraduate degree in Clinical Research, Clinical Trials, Epidemiology, Public Health or a related discipline from a recognised university Additional qualification or prior training in Medical Laboratory Technology or a related laboratory discipline Experience in clinical research, preferably involving the collection, processing, storage and transport of biological samples, and the related documentation Experience in preparing SOPs and study workplans, and in coordinating study activities Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certification Skills listed: computer skills in Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Access; documentation, communication and organisational skills; managing several tasks at once; and working both independently and in a team. All qualifications must be from a recognised Board/University. Experience counts only if it was gained after obtaining the minimum educational qualification for the post. THSTI will not answer queries about eligibility. Candidates must check for themselves that they meet the criteria. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

rows.relaxation: Up to 5 years, as per Central Government orders
To the extent of service rendered, as on the closing date of the advertisement
Service rendered in the defence forces plus 3 years, with a minimum of 6 months of attested service

content_sections.heading: Job Profile
content_sections.text: Prepare Data Management documents: DMP, DVP/Edit Checks Document, Annotated CRF and Data Entry Guideline Quality-check the database design, validation programs, data extract views and final data listings; design CRFs Handle query management, data cleaning, data freezing, data archival and E/SAE reconciliation Work to GCDMP, CDM SOPs and CDISC & SDTM standards; integrate medical dictionaries and do medical coding Prepare interim reports and datasets for analysis with the statistician; create charts and dashboards Use LIMS to track requisitions and specimen status; handle data requests from third parties Protect data security and the confidentiality of participants Develop SOPs, train study staff and supervise data management activities at the clinical site Support the coordination of clinical studies, including ethics and institutional approvals Monitor laboratory processes from sample collection to testing, following SOPs and GCLP principles Develop and maintain protocols, SOPs, CRFs and trial manuals Support trial close-out, including database lock, site close-out and archiving Conduct site monitoring visits from site initiation through close-out Contribute to manuscripts, grant reports and conference presentations Train study teams, and carry out any other project duties the Principal Investigator assigns

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected at the walk-in. The notice says candidates attend a written test, skill test or interview. If many candidates apply, THSTI will screen them and shortlist those with higher or more relevant qualifications and experience. Results and notifications will be published only on the THSTI website, and all communication will be by email.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: These are short-term project positions. Extensions depend on satisfactory performance and on the tenure of the project. Appointees will have no claim to regularisation of their employment. Where this notification does not cover a matter, the bye-laws of THSTI and Govt. of India rules apply. Canvassing or giving wrong information in any form will lead to disqualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for THSTI Data Manager and Project Research Scientist-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the essential qualification, experience and age limit for the post. Go to THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001, on your post's interview date. Report by 09:00 AM. Candidates who arrive after the time slot will not be allowed to take part. At reception, hand in your mobile phone with a valid identity proof. Both are returned only after the whole selection process is over. What to bring: Your latest resume One set of photocopies of your educational qualification and experience documents The original documents for verification A valid ID card

faq.question: Q1. Which project are these posts for?
faq.answer: Both posts are under the project "Sepsis related mortality in neonates in India: A multi-disciplinary, multi-institutional research program for context specific solutions", run by CDSA at THSTI.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Each post pays emoluments of Rs. 56,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q3. Can a graduate apply for the Data Manager post?
faq.answer: Yes. A graduate in any field (preferably science) can apply with 8 years of relevant experience. A candidate with a Master's degree needs 6 years.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Post Graduate Degree, and integrated PG degrees are accepted. GCP certification and clinical research experience are only desirable.

faq.question: Q5. Does experience gained before the qualification count?
faq.answer: No. Only experience gained after the minimum educational qualification for the post is counted.

faq.question: Q6. How much age relaxation do SC/ST and OBC candidates get?
faq.answer: SC/ST candidates get 5 years and OBC candidates get 3 years. PwBD candidates get 10 years (UR), 13 years (OBC) or 15 years (SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. What happens if I reach the venue late?
faq.answer: Candidates who arrive after the 09:00 AM time slot will not be allowed to take part.

faq.question: Q8. Can I keep my mobile phone during the selection?
faq.answer: No. You must hand in your phone with a valid identity proof at reception. Both are returned when the whole selection process is complete.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. These are short-term project positions, and appointees will have no claim to regularisation. Extensions depend on performance and on the tenure of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Where will results be announced?
faq.answer: Results and notifications will be published only on the THSTI website, and THSTI will contact candidates only by email.
